title: Authenticate as a service principal using OAuth OBO (Beta)
body:
You can now use OAuth on-behalf-of (OBO) to obtain tokens that act with a service principal's identity instead of your own user account. You must have the **Service Principal Manager** role on the service principal.

See [Authenticate as a service principal using OAuth OBO](/aws/en/dev-tools/auth/oauth-m2m#oauth-obo).
